# User Story Traceability Matrix

This page maps each user story under `docs/reference/user_stories/` to the requirements that cite it in their `stories:` field.
The spec files are the authoritative side of the story graph (ADR-0072), so this page is generated from them and a hand edit fails `uv run docs-site --check`.
To change an entry, change the citing requirement's `stories:` field in `specs/` and regenerate.

A story that no requirement cites is marked *No mapped requirements* (TRACE-01-002).
Each requirement links the row that defines its anchor: the Requirements Catalog for a `protocol` or `foundation` requirement, its tier page for any other kind.
